name: request_loan
description: Log in with the given username and password, open the Request Loan page, enter the loan amount in the Loan Amount field and the down payment in the Down Payment field, select the given account as the from account, click Apply Now, and read the loan application status into an output named loan_status

approved_plan.goal: Log in with the given username and password, open the Request Loan page, enter the loan amount in the Loan Amount field and the down payment in the Down Payment field, select the given account as the from account, click Apply Now, and read the loan application status into an output named loan_status

steps.intent: Log in with the supplied username and password and reach the Accounts Overview page
steps.action: Replay the parabank_login@1.0.0 fragment using the provided username and password credentials

steps.intent: Navigate to the Request Loan page
steps.action: Locate and click the 'Request Loan' link in the navigation menu to open the Request Loan page

steps.intent: Enter the loan amount in the Loan Amount field
steps.action: Find the Loan Amount input field and type the value of loan_amount into it

steps.intent: Enter the down payment in the Down Payment field
steps.action: Find the Down Payment input field and type the value of down_payment into it

steps.intent: Select the given account as the from account
steps.action: Find the 'From Account' dropdown and select the option matching account_id
Click the 'Apply Now' button to submit the loan application

steps.intent: Read the loan application status into the loan_status output
steps.action: Locate the loan application status text on the confirmation/result page and capture it as loan_status

hardening_rejected: s06_click: detector 'det_loan_denied' rejected: 'Denied' is visible on the page the run just succeeded on, so it can never distinguish that outcome from a genuine one
review_notes: s06_click: only one locator candidate (role_name) — no fallback if it stops matching
